questions.questionText:
Net solar radiation of 1360 W⁡m-2 is incident on the surface of a still lake having
mixed layer depth of 20 m. Find the change in temperature (in SI units) of the mixed
layer of the lake for a day length of 8 hours. (Rounded off to 2 decimal places) Assume that there is no variation in solar radiation in a day and all radiation incident
on the surface is absorbed uniformly throughout the mixed layer (Density of lake
water is 1025 kg⁡m-3 and Specific heat capacity (Cp) of lake water is 3850
J⁡kg-1⁡K-1).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 0.45 to 0.55.
